migrationFailure: STOP N; no N+1, ledger repair or blind retry. UNKNOWN commit: new readonly connection, verify and operator review.
applicationFailure: Feature OFF/allowlists EMPTY; restore preserved known-good application files only, retain DB migrations; if old app incompatible HOLD and separate forward-fix authorization.
productionRestore: Only confirmed data corruption plus separate incident authorization
freshBackup: REQUIRED AT EXECUTION WINDOW; <=15m unless explicit exception
